about.summary: Frontend developer focused on creating modern, intuitive, responsive web interfaces. I work with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, building projects that combine a good user experience with maintainable code. I enjoy learning and building solutions to real problems.

hoppscotch.summary: Contributed to a frontend issue about state synchronization, focusing on consistent interface behavior and maintainable code.

jobtracker.description: Web application to manage selection processes, organize candidates, and track vacancies and interviews from a centralized interface

listofbooks.description: Web application developed with React that allows exploring and organizing books by genre. Includes category filters and dynamic counters to facilitate navigation through the collection.

blog.description: Blog developed with React, Vite, and TypeScript that integrates a Markdown editor, organization by categories, and features to interact with publications.

iphone15.description: Landing page inspired by the iPhone 15 Pro, focused on creating a modern and adaptable (responsive) visual experience. I developed the interface from scratch, working on the structure, design, and product presentation.
